name: context-meter
description: Shows the context window's fill after every turn and, past a threshold, says it is time to write a hand-off document and start a new session.

warnPercent.title: Warn at (%)
warnPercent.description: Context fill at which the status line and the band say it is hand-off time.

urgentPercent.title: Urgent at (%)
urgentPercent.description: Context fill at which the band turns red.

handoffPrompt.title: Hand-off prompt
handoffPrompt.description: The prompt the Draft hand-off button submits.
handoffPrompt.default: Context is getting large. Write a hand-off document for this session following the project's hand-off conventions, so a new session can continue from it.
